source_claims.statement: Empirically measured OMNS lookup times. Long paths insufficient. Recursive dirs better. Symbolic links and hash collisions multiplicative. Shadow directories reduced setup cost. Final technique yields multi-second to multi-minute windows.

research_questions.formulation: What OMNS mechanisms can expand a race window enough for reliable exploitation when a check is followed by resource access?

negative_inconclusive: Hash collision insertion quadratic and slow
layer_b_candidate_principles: When a race window is too small, systematically measure and compose slowdowns in the resource lookup path rather than abandoning the class
Kernel disassembly can reveal multiplicative factors (hash collisions) that empirical testing alone misses
